# Mutation transcript — Codex round 14 (P3 Task 6 create-error fix wave)

Durable mutation evidence for the round-14 fix wave (the create-family
`to`-exemption narrowing in `cmd/reconcile/admin_trace.go`), extending the
in-package durable convention started by `r13.md`. Round 14's finding: the
decoder accepted every CREATE/CREATE2 lacking `to` although geth v1.13.0
removes a create's `to` ONLY in `processOutput`'s error arm, which has
already set the frame's non-empty `error` (eth/tracers/native/call.go:70-79;
`error` marshals under omitempty, call.go:53) — so a degraded response that
drops `to`, `error` and the nested calls of a SUCCESSFUL creation could scan
clean and conceal an admin-write child frame. The fix presence-tracks the
frame `error` and conditions the exemption on it. Per the round-14
reviewer's ask, mE is RE-CUT against the new code (its r13 diff no longer
applies) and mF is the new exemption-widening mutant.

## Tested tree

- Branch `main`, HEAD `705e0d93fc4c761c7e4f50c689a7a3b70c43f256`, PLUS this
  wave's uncommitted round-14 changes (the mutants were cut against the
  FIXED code, behaviourally, after the wave's regression (d) went
  RED-then-green).

  mutants, and the after-restore hash for both — restores verified
  byte-identical, CRLF as committed):
  `73446cb999b565a45c134e70dd0aff752a934857d3d3a6c39f3a2322396cec96`
- Kill-suite command (scoped, hermetic — no DB rows consulted by these tests):

  with `TEST_DATABASE_URL` / `SOLVENT_DATABASE_URL` set per the wave brief.
- The mutated-file hashes below are the sha256 of the exact bytes on disk at
  test time (CRLF), recorded immediately before each kill run.

## mE — the round-13 strict-frame law reverted (RE-CUT against the round-14 code)

Spec (unchanged from the `admin_trace_test.go` header; re-cut here because
the round-14 fix changed `frameTargetsAdminWrite`, so the r13 diff and hash
are stale): the strict walk gutted back to the pre-round-13 lenient shape —
frame type unchecked, `to` via `common.FromHex` with malformed treated as
non-targeting, `input` via `common.FromHex` with hex errors silently
discarded, absent-input checked only on proxy-targeting frames. The
pre-round-13 shape necessarily also DROPS the round-14 error conjunct (it
never read `fr.Error`), so this re-cut subsumes the round-14 reversal too.

## Real-fixture guard

`TestCapturedTraceScansReplayToTheirPinnedOutcome` (31/31 scans clean, 30
committed envelopes — one block is shared by two cases) passed unmodified
against the FIXED code and stayed green under BOTH mutants. A direct sweep
of the 30 committed envelopes found exactly 3 create-family frames (in 2
envelopes), every one carrying a present `to` (successful creations) — the
captures contain NO to-less create at all, so the round-14 narrowing cannot
touch them, and nothing in the real captures contradicts the geth-shape
claim (a to-less create without `error` was never observed).
